name: Unit sequence switch
summary: Selects or determines the order in which multiple units enter an operating sequence.
description: Selects or determines the order in which multiple units enter an operating sequence.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the selected unit order and selector positions. The associated drawing should trace the unit-specific start-permission circuits; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the selected unit order and selector positions.
drawingChecklist: Label the selected unit order and selector positions.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: Unit ordering differs from device 34, which sequences the operations inside a unit or system.
